selfServiceTiers.description: Voice and digital self-service resources an interaction can traverse. Per interaction (billing ID), only the highest-ranked tier visited is billed; lower tiers on the same interaction are not billed separately.

tiers.name: IVR (Architect inbound call / message flow)
tiers.notes: 0 EU. IVR time is not an EU charge, but it is billed in currency per minute once the org's pooled fair-use IVR minutes are used up (see fairUse.ivrMinutes). That charge applies on top of whatever tier the interaction is billed at.

tiers.name: Bot flow (Genesys Dialog Engine / Digital Bot Flow)
Virtual Agent (incl. agentic VA powered by Guides)

interactionBoundary.description: One billing ID per interaction, any channel, any length. A billing ID can span several end-interaction events (e.g. inbound flow -> VA flow). Billing closes when an action ends it and no further transfer can occur.

billingRules.rule: Self-service resources on one interaction are billed at the single highest tier visited, by tier rank (bot < VA < AVA), not by computed cost. A long bot call that later reaches AVA is billed 1.2 EU only.
AVA charge (1.2 EU) is triggered by entering a flow that contains an AVA block, not by executing it.
Channel meters (messaging, social) are independent of the self-service tier and add on top (e.g. a WhatsApp conversation handled by a VA = 0.5 EU + 1 EU per 400 messages).
Fixed (per-user) elements are billed per user per month regardless of usage.
Free/included allocations net against total monthly EUs; unused units expire monthly.

IVR minutes are not EUs. IVR (and, by default, bot) flow time on a voice call draws down the org's pooled fair-use IVR minutes until the call is handed to a VA or AVA; VA/AVA time does not count. Minutes beyond the pool are billed per minute in currency, independent of the EU tier.

fairUse.description: Non-EU allowances that interact with self-service design. Pooled across the org each month (per billable user x per-user allowance), based on the greater of commit or actual users. No carry-over. Overage billed in currency, not EUs.

ivrMinutes.name: Basic routing / IVR minutes
ivrMinutes.measuredAs: Self-service flow time on a voice call until it is handed to a VA or AVA: Architect IVR flow time, plus bot flow time by default (toggle). Time in VA/AVA is not counted (confirmed by Chad 2026-11-12). In-queue flows are excluded.
